conclusion: This G/G genotype carries no A allele at rs9978858. In Dinh 2025 (PMID 41405793), a European-ancestry multivariate GWAS of a latent factor (mvARD) shared by heart attack, high cholesterol, hypertension, stroke and type 2 diabetes, each A allele at rs9978858 was associated with lower mvARD (beta -0.01221, SE 0.0022; P=2.763e-08). The label here is a relative position under that additive model, not a claim of protection from disease or of longer life.
